siteMeta.title: Amr Mahmoud - Escape Room Portfolio
siteMeta.description: An interactive escape-room portfolio set in a dark Arch Linux battlestation. Click the room to explore projects, skills and live terminals.
siteMeta.ogDescription: Explore a backend engineer's portfolio by clicking around a dark, aesthetic coding room — complete with working terminals.

resume.summary: Back-End Engineer and Computer Science student with experience building RESTful APIs, authentication systems, and database-driven backends using Node.js, Laravel, and Flask. Strong foundation in data structures, system design, and Linux-based development environments.

timeline.title: CS-Club Vice-President & Instructor
timeline.detail: Taught Version Control (Git & GitHub) for three lectures that helped students understand basic Git command and how to collaborate with others via GitHub.

timeline.title: Android Development Trainee
timeline.detail: Developed native Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Worked within MVVM-based Android architecture, integrating backend APIs.

timeline.title: IT Field Intern
timeline.detail: Developed backend solutions for university website and course catalogue using Laravel. Developed Student Affairs portal using Laravel, React and Paymob. Gained practical understanding of networking fundamentals.

timeline.title: BSc Computer Science
timeline.detail: GPA: 3.51/4.0. Full Scholarship Recipient through Innovators Support Fund (ISF). CS-Club Vice president.

projects.name: E-JUST SIS
projects.description: Architected a Node.js/PostgreSQL admissions backend managing 90+ REST API endpoints across 15 modules. Secured multi-role access (Staff, Staff-Admin, Student, IT-Admin) using JWT-based RBAC.
highlights: Architected modular backend managing 90+ REST API endpoints
Implemented robust JWT-based Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Integrated asynchronous job queues using BullMQ & Redis
Comprehensive API documentation and testing via API Dog

projects.name: Campus Connect
projects.description: Developed a cross-platform university engagement portal for E-JUST students featuring event management, club discovery, room booking, facility reservations, and social feed. Built RESTful API with Express.js connected to MariaDB.
highlights: Built robust backend REST API using Node.js, Express, and MariaDB
Developed comprehensive features: event management, room booking, social feed
Implemented secure JWT authentication and data validation with Zod
Cross-platform support serving university student engagement needs

projects.name: Green Rabbit
projects.description: A financial market assistant application powered by the Perplexity AI API, delivering real-time market insights, portfolio analysis, and personalized investment guidance through a conversational interface.
highlights: Integrated Perplexity AI API for intelligent conversational insights
Engineered scheduled cron jobs for automated real-time market data ingestion
Implemented complex portfolio analysis and breakdown algorithms
Deployed scalable architecture using Railway, Docker, and Redis queues

certificates.title: DEPI Completion
certificates.detail: Completed the Android development track with a graduation project.

certificates.title: Backend Engineering Track
certificates.detail: Distributed systems, message queues, and containerized deployments.
